verdict.summary_en: Polish WZ delivery note WZ-261116-473 dated 16.11.2026 from Karton Nowak (Poznań) to Soony DC Hamburg for PO 4500318768, one line CMP-GAM-008 Art Book Grand Heist 6. The printed quantity 80.000 PCS (80,000) is crossed out and replaced by a handwritten 8 000 (8,000). Stamped received 18.11.2026 at DC-HAM and signed Meyer K.
red_flags: Quantity corrected by hand: printed 80.000 (80,000 PCS) struck through, handwritten 8 000 (8,000 PCS) — a tenfold difference.
The correction has no initials, explanation or remark; the 'Uwagi' (remarks) field is empty.
Header shows 40 packages and 360 kg gross, which do not state which quantity they match. They are not changed by the correction.
Product description is cut off ('96 p, hard'), so the full description is not readable.
The receiving stamp and signature do not state whether the received quantity is the corrected 8,000 or the printed 80,000.
observations: Printed 80.000 is struck through with a diagonal line; the handwritten '8 000' sits just below the row, outside the table.
Blue receiving stamp 'RECEIVED 18.11.2026 / DC-HAM' is clear.
Handwritten signature 'Meyer K.' on the Odebrał line.
Description text is truncated at the cell edge.
Barcode at the top right; the lower half of the page is blank.
